messages:
lia: FYI PR #51789 is hitting intermittent network timeouts in CI, can we get runtime + infra + security eyes? failing ~10% of runs and blocking the merge before EOD Friday

sam: can you paste the failing log snippet? :eyes: might be a test infra flake not the code itself

lia: sure — here's the most common stack we see in the CI job (integration suite):
```
ERROR: request to http://10.0.5.12:8080/health timed out after 10s
  at onTimeout (node:internal/timers:564:11)
  at processTimers (node:internal/timers:507:7)
```
this happens during model-cache warmup test, started after the eviction change in 6f2d8b3

infra-bot: CI job 51789-integration failed 7/70 runs (timeout). Latest rerun triggered at 2026-03-16T14:12:08Z. Link: https://ci.redwood/51789

ben: @lia thanks, looks like the test VM is occasionally dropping packets during the warmup requests. can you confirm which infra pool this ran on? (gcp-us-central-2-pool-a?)

lia: yes, most failures on gcp-us-central-2-pool-a. I also saw one on gcp-us-central-1 but 90% are on pool-a

nina: I can take a look at the runtime side tomorrow morning — want to check KV cache rehydration and whether the warmup sequence is retrying correctly. which branch/sha is this?

lia: PR branch is feature/eviction-adapt-51789, latest commit 6f2d8b3. Test that fails is integration::model_warmup::kv_warmup

james: security question — does the warmup perform any auth or call external endpoints? curious if failed retries could leak credentials or trigger rate limits on a 3rd-party service

lia: no external endpoints, all internal vpc calls. auth is mTLS between services so no creds in logs. rate limit not likely since this is intra-cluster traffic

ben: quick mitigation we can try: temporarily increase the test request timeout to 30s in the job to stop noisy flakes while we debug. non-ideal but gives breathing room for the merge window. Thoughts?

sam: that's reasonable for short-term. also add an explicit retry (1 retry with exponential backoff) in the warmup test so transient drops don't fail the run

nina: agreed on short-term. longer term I'll trace the warmup path and confirm whether KV cache logic blocks on a single endpoint that might be saturated. will post findings by 10:00 PT tomorrow

james: fine with the temporary timeout bump. please include a note in the PR description that it's temporary and link an issue to revert after root cause found :+1:

lia: will do. for the immediate ask: can @ben toggle a rerun with bumped timeout and @nina take runtime look tomorrow? if both ok I can schedule merge after a clean green run

ben: I can flip the timeout on the pipeline and trigger 3 reruns now. ping me in channel when you want me to revert

lia: thanks — triggering now. will paste rerun ids and any new logs here. really appreciate quick eyes everyone :heart:

infra-bot: Reruns started: 51789-rerun-1, 51789-rerun-2, 51789-rerun-3

sam: nice, if reruns pass can we fast-track the merge? small change and rollback plan exists

nina: once I confirm no runtime regressions I'll +1 for canary. aiming to look first thing tomorrow

lia: noted — will update this thread with results and the temporary timeout PR note. thanks all!
